Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing an enhanced penalty for the use of an internet advertisement to facilitate the commission of a sex-trafficking crime.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing an enhanced penalty for the use ofan internet advertisement to facilitate the commission of asex-trafficking crime; adding a new section to chapter 9.68A RCW;repealing RCW 9.68A.104; repealing 2012 c 138 s 1 (uncodified); andrepealing 2012 c 138 s 3 (uncodified).
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.68A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In addition to all other penalties under this chapter, a personconvicted of an offense under RCW 9.68A.100, 9.68A.101, or 9.68A.102shall be assessed an additional fee of five thousand dollars peroffense when the court finds that an internet advertisement in whichthe victim of the crime was described or depicted was instrumental infacilitating the commission of the crime. (2) For purposes of this section, an "internet advertisement" meansa statement in electronic media that would be understood by areasonable person to be an implicit or explicit offer for sexualcontact or sexual intercourse, both as defined in chapter 9A.44 RCW, inexchange for something of value. p. 1 SB 5488 (3) Amounts collected as penalties under this section shall bedeposited in the account established under RCW 43.63A.740.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 9.68A.104 (Advertising commercial sexual abuse of a minorPenalty) and 2012 c 138 s 2; 2012 c 138 s 1 (uncodified); and 2012 c 138 s 3 (uncodified).
